issues.description: scripts/lib/archive_runner.py:631 except Exception 过宽——resolve_main_repo_root 已明确抛 WorktreeBootstrapError(reason='porcelain_malformed'/'main_root_missing')（来源：scripts/lib/worktree_manager.py:616），应改窄为 except WorktreeBootstrapError 让真正意外异常向上传播；当前写法掩盖意外异常类型
